tool_input.command: grep -rnE "StorefrontTestBase|PriceCache|ApplyPercentOff|PriceCatalog|^public class" tests src | grep -vE "PromotionTests.cs|PriceCacheTests.cs|Pricing/PriceCache.cs|Pricing/PriceCatalog.cs"; which dotnet && dotnet --version
tool_input.description: Find other users of the shared price cache and check dotnet availability

tool_input.command: sed -i '' -e 's/^public class CatalogTests$/public class CatalogTests : StorefrontTestBase/' -e 's/^public class PromotionTests$/public class PromotionTests : StorefrontTestBase/' -e '/private readonly PriceCatalog _catalog = PriceCatalog.Default();/{N;d;}' -e 's/_catalog\./Catalog./g' tests/Storefront.Specs/CatalogTests.cs tests/Storefront.Specs/PromotionTests.cs && git diff
tool_input.description: Make CatalogTests and PromotionTests inherit the cache-clearing test base

result:
- **Cause:** Test pollution through the static `PriceCache`. `PromotionTests.Promotion_ReducesPrice_WhileActive` puts MUG on 20% off (10.00) and never ends the promotion. `CatalogTests` didn't clear the cache, so when it ran after `PromotionTests` it read the leftover promo price instead of 12.50. It is order-dependent, and the `TryPriceOf` change itself is not at fault.
- **Action:** Test-only change in `tests/Storefront.Specs/CatalogTests.cs` and `tests/Storefront.Specs/PromotionTests.cs`. Both now inherit `StorefrontTestBase`, which clears the cache before each test, and use its `Catalog` instead of their own `_catalog` field.

The catalog, promotion and price-cache tests pass locally (11/11); I did not run the full suite. The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline won't go green until it is.
